title: ui.config.json reference
summary: Key-by-key reference for ui.config.json: types, defaults and allowed values for name, preset, kind, brand, color, radius, type, density, sizes, space, surface, nav, avatars and motion.
notes: No filename/path SPEC convention (lives in docs/), so medium. Content is a config schema contract: key/type/default/allowed-value tables, generated --uis- role names, error behavior (unknown pin keys throw). Reads like reference DOC too, but the data-model contract dominates; resolved to SPEC per ambiguity rule. Output filename uses path-derived suffix 'docs-config' instead of SHA-256 hash: no shell available to compute it.
